proposed_source.text:
September 16, 2026

Simulated Committee issues synthetic statement

For release at 2:00 p.m. EDT

The Simulated Committee decided to keep its synthetic policy setting unchanged at 3 percent.

Synthetic indicators suggest that activity expanded at a moderate pace in the third quarter.

Voting for the synthetic action were Member A, Member B and Member C.
